ja217:1.1: All the world has delight (in lovemaking),
ja217:1.2: You are unskilled in village ways, Seggu,
ja217:1.3: Child, how is this thing known to you today?
ja217:1.4: Having grabbed you, you cry out in the woods.
ja217:2.1: The one who should shelter me from suffering,
ja217:2.2: My father, is treacherous inside the woods,
ja217:2.3: To whom will I cry out amidst the woods?
ja217:2.4: He who protects me, offers violence.
